series.name: Floor Standing — Glamour+ / Gallant+
series.notes: Floor-standing Dawlance units (Glamour+/Gallant+ FS) use the same display codes as the splits — ALL codes in inverter-split.json also apply here (shared platform). This file holds only the floor-standing-specific evidence. Official Gallant FS Inverter 45 manual (F01000000160) is a scanned PDF whose pages were reviewed: display legend only (dF/CF/SC/FP), no numeric E/F/P table. Service UAN 021-111-11-7359.

title.ur: Floor-standing unit par FC code (drive / 4-way valve)

meaning.en: FC is documented specifically on Dawlance vertical/floor-standing displays by technician videos; no official meaning published. Similar platforms: compressor drive module or 4-way valve switching fault.
meaning.ur: FC khaas taur par Dawlance floor-standing display par technician videos se document hua; official meaning nahi. Similar platform: compressor drive ya 4-way valve switching fault.

causes.en: 4-way valve switching fault on heat & cool models (typical)
causes.ur: Heat & cool models par 4-way valve switching fault (aam)

solutions.en: On heat models, technician checks 4-way valve coil and switching
solutions.ur: Heat models par technician 4-way valve coil aur switching check kare
